name: Мат слоном і конем
description:
Another lesson about checkmate. You are going to checkmate the black king with a knight and bishop.

This can only be done if the other side’s pieces help a little bit. For example, when the black pawns stand in the way of the king.

Take a look at the examples.

 

What do you have do?

Checkmate the king with your knight and bishop.

examples.text: The knight attacks the king and the bishop removes the king's flight squares.
Now the roles of the bishop and knight have been reversed. The bishop attacks the king and the knight takes an escape square from the king.

texts: Checkmate in 1 move! Use the coordination between your knight and bishop.
